verdict.rationale: The evidence shows VLP advises clients on "entity formation" as a paid service, but nothing shows the firm publishes guidance on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction. Nothing mentions Delaware C-corp versus UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd comparisons, and the firm appears US-only (Palo Alto contact). Bespoke advisory work is an adjacent service, not published jurisdiction-selection guidance, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
